notes: Whosoever he be is kept whole with 'ish as the ASV's universalizing rendering of the noun; the alternative of splitting he be onto the following min as a copula is named in that unit's note.

hayah is written in the relative clause, so it takes hath under rule 43 and its preposition goes unrepresented; the suffix is unrepresented because the written relative has supplied the English subject.
